mapper.sql: saved.id AS saved_id, saved.saved_at, program.source_code, program.source_program_id, program.title, program.organization, program.summary, program.categories, program.regions, program.target_description, program.application_period_raw, program.application_start_date, program.application_end_date, program.source_url, program.source_sort_timestamp, program.startup_details
mapper.select:
SELECT
FROM saved_support_program saved JOIN support_program program ON program.id = saved.support_program_id WHERE saved.account_id = #{accountId} AND program.is_source_present = TRUE ORDER BY saved.saved_at DESC, saved.id DESC

SELECT id FROM saved_support_program WHERE source_prefetch_status = 'PENDING' AND (source_prefetch_next_publish_at IS NULL OR source_prefetch_next_publish_at <= #{now}) ORDER BY source_prefetch_next_publish_at, id LIMIT 20

SELECT
FROM saved_support_program saved JOIN support_program program ON program.id = saved.support_program_id WHERE saved.id = #{id} AND saved.source_prefetch_status = 'PUBLISHED' AND program.is_source_present = TRUE
mapper.update: UPDATE saved_support_program SET source_prefetch_status = #{status}, source_prefetch_updated_at = #{now}, source_prefetch_next_publish_at = NULL WHERE id = #{id} AND source_prefetch_status = 'PUBLISHED'
